turns.assessment: The anomaly is local to trx.och66.z: all of its receiver and unit telemetry remained unchanged, while the far-end interface, channel monitors, and amplifiers on och66 showed no corresponding optical-path change. The two OCM OSNR changes are on unrelated sections and occurred after the estimated onset. A local card failure that leaves monitoring silent or stale is therefore the documented mode that best explains the frozen reading.

proposals.rationale: A failed line-interface card can stop valid monitoring and leave apparently frozen telemetry. The absence of changes at the far end and throughout the och66 optical path argues strongly against a real received-power change caused upstream.
This is receiver-local, but it should normally produce error or penalty changes rather than freeze all monitored quantities, so it is a poor fit.
